ordered_diagnoses: Metastatic dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans to the thyroid

candidates.name: Anaplastic thyroid cancer
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the right lobe yielded a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results are consistent with a rapidly growing thyroid tumor.

candidates.name: Papillary thyroid cancer
support_spans: Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the right lobe yielded a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei
Contrast-enhanced CT of the neck and thorax confirmed a voluminous right thyroid mass and detected two pulmonary nodules consistent with metastases
candidates.why: The presence of a large thyroid mass and pulmonary nodules is consistent with metastatic thyroid cancer.

candidates.name: Medullary thyroid cancer
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck

candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results could be consistent with medullary thyroid cancer, although the biopsy results are not specific for this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Papillary thyroid carcinoma
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck

candidates.why: The patient's presentation with a large neck mass and suspicious fine-needle aspiration biopsy results suggests a primary thyroid malignancy.

candidates.name: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck
the entire right lobe was replaced by a hypo- to anechoic mass measuring approximately 6 × 4 × 6 cm
candidates.why: The rapid growth and aggressive nature of the thyroid mass, as well as the patient's age, raise concern for anaplastic thyroid carcinoma.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis is rare and may be underconsidered in favor of more common thyroid malignancies.

contradict_spans: Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the right lobe yielded a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei

candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis is rare and may be overlooked due to the primary focus on thyroid pathology.

selector.rationale: The patient's presentation with a large, firm, and mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck, along with the fine-needle aspiration biopsy results showing a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei, supports the diagnosis of anaplastic thyroid cancer. The absence of significant thyroid antibody elevation and the presence of a rapidly growing mass also favor this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Medullary thyroid cancer
rejected.why: Lack of specific supporting evidence, such as elevated calcitonin levels.

rejected.label: Papillary thyroid carcinoma
rejected.why: While some findings are consistent with papillary thyroid carcinoma, the presence of a large and rapidly growing mass, along with the biopsy results, makes anaplastic thyroid cancer a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
rejected.why: This is essentially the same diagnosis as anaplastic thyroid cancer, and the champion diagnosis is preferred for its simplicity.

rejected.label: Metastatic dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans to the thyroid
rejected.why: The biopsy results showing pleomorphic round and oval nuclei are not typical for dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, making this diagnosis less likely.
